<label data-l10n-id="accent-color-selection-label"
             control="accentColor"/>
      <hbox flex="1">
        <menulist id="accentColor" preference="mail.appearance.accentColor">
          <menupopup native="false">
            <menuitem value="accent-color" class="accent-color-os"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-os"/>
            <menuitem value="thunderbird" class="accent-color-thunderbird"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-thunderbird"/>
            <menuitem value="purple" class="accent-color-purple"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-purple"/>
            <menuitem value="orange" class="accent-color-orange"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-orange"/>
            <menuitem value="pink" class="accent-color-pink"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-pink"/>
            <menuitem value="ink" class="accent-color-ink"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-ink"/>
            <menuitem value="teal" class="accent-color-teal"
                      data-l10n-id="accent-color-teal"/>
          </menupopup>
        </menulist>
      </hbox>
    </hbox>
    <description id="accentColorDisabledDescription"
                 data-l10n-id="accent-color-disabled-description"
                 class="tip-caption"/>
  </html:fieldset>

  <html:fieldset id="layoutGroup" data-category="paneAppearance">
    <html:legend data-l10n-id="window-layout-legend"></html:legend>
    <hbox>
      <checkbox id="drawInTitlebar"
                data-l10n-id="hide-titlebar-label"
                preference="mail.tabs.drawInTitlebar"/>
      <description class="indent tip-caption"
                   data-l10n-id="hide-titlebar-description" />
    </hbox>
    <hbox>
      <vbox>
        <checkbox id="autoHideTabbar"
                  data-l10n-id="hide-tabbar-single-tab-label"
                  preference="mail.tabs.autoHide"/>
        <description data-l10n-id="auto-hide-tabbar-second-tab-description"
                     class="tip-caption indent"/>
      </vbox>
    </hbox>
  </html:fieldset>

  <html:fieldset data-category="paneAppearance">
    <html:legend data-l10n-id="default-message-list-legend"></html:legend>
    <separator class="thin"/>

    <label control="appearanceViewStyle"
           data-l10n-id="appearance-view-style-select"/>
    <radiogroup id="appearanceViewStyle"
                class="indent appearance-options"
                preference="mail.threadpane.listview">
      <radio id="appearanceStyleCards"
             value="0"
             data-l10n-id="appearance-radio-card-view" />
      <radio id="appearanceStyleTable"
             value="1"
             data-l10n-id="appearance-radio-table" />
    </radiogroup>

    <separator/>

    <html:div id="cardsViewOptions" hidden="hidden">
      <html:legend data-l10n-id="card-view-options-legend"></html:legend>
      <separator class="thin"/>
      <label control="appearanceCardRows" data-l10n-id="appearance-card-rows" />

      <radiogroup id="appearanceCardRows"
                  class="indent"
                  preference="mail.threadpane.cardsview.rowcount">
        <radio id="cardStyle2Rows"
               value="2"
               data-l10n-id="appearance-card-style-2" />
        <radio id="cardStyle3Rows"
               value="3"
               data-l10n-id="appearance-card-style-3" />
      </radiogroup>
    </html:div>

    <html:div id="tableViewOptions" hidden="hidden">
      <html:legend data-l10n-id="table-view-legend"></html:legend>
      <separator class="thin"/>
      <hbox>
        <checkbox id="tableHorizontalScroll"
                  data-l10n-id="table-layout-horizontal-scroll-label"
                  preference="mail.threadpane.table.horizontal_scroll"/>
      </hbox>
    </html:div>
  </html:fieldset>

  <html:div data-category="paneAppearance">
    <vbox id="appearance-notifications">
      <!-- notificationbox will be added here lazily. -->
    </vbox>

    <html:fieldset>
      <html:legend data-l10n-id="default-message-list-sorting-legend"></html:legend>
      <description flex="1" data-l10n-id="default-message-list-new-folders-description"/>

      <separator/>

      <label control="defaultViewFlags" data-l10n-id="default-flag-label" />
      <radiogroup id="defaultViewFlags"
                  class="indent appearance-options"
                  preference="mailnews.default_view_flags">
        <radio id="defaultFlagUnthreaded"
               value="0"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-unthreaded" />
        <radio id="defaultFlagThreaded"
               value="1"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-threaded" />
        <radio id="defaultFlagGrouped"
               value="64"
               data-l10n-id="default-flag-grouped" />
      </radiogroup>
